statement: Reference shared-electronics CLASSES for an engineering calculation case only — NOT a final BOM and NOT a procurement decision. Classes are representative of a low-power wearable; exact currents are kept unresolved where not frozen so that NO system power is implied.

mcu.reference_class: ARM Cortex-M4F-class BLE wearable SoC (e.g. Nordic nRF52-class)
selection_criteria_met: aggregate reference data rate (tens of kbps)

active_current.note: representative class ~mA active; exact point NOT frozen

sleep_current.note: representative ~uA deep-sleep; exact point NOT frozen

mcu.note: No exact current is used in any power sum; system power stays NOT_READY by construction.

continuous_stream_reference.description: BLE continuous streaming of raw/lightly-processed data

buffered_burst_reference.description: Local storage + intermittent BLE burst upload
buffered_burst_reference.duty: low radio-on fraction, higher local storage

rails_distinguished: sensor/analog rail (e.g. 3.3 V for TMP117/OPT3001; 5 V AVDD for EEG)
digital rail (1.8 V AFE cores / DVDD)

efficiency.note: NOT frozen; an arbitrary 90% is explicitly NOT applied. Efficiency would be a labelled reference assumption ONLY when a system power calc is authorised.

mass.note: no cell datasheet frozen; mass NOT asserted

battery.runtime_note: No runtime computed — system average power is NOT_READY.

data_rate_requirement_reference: See results/reference_data_rate_budget_day11.json (partial raw payload ~48 kbps, radio rate NOT_READY).
